representation: Price-quantity graph with fixed supply and demand lines, a movable horizontal ceiling line below equilibrium, blue and green quantity dots at the ceiling, and a red shortage arrow between them.
motion: The ceiling line, Qd dot, Qs dot and shortage arrow all move together as the ceiling-price slider changes; their horizontal gap is the shortage.
controls: slider for the ceiling price from $30 to $54
checkpoints: Qd and Qs separate at the ceiling
ceiling is nonbinding at or above equilibrium
shortage is a gap, not zero supply
misconceptionTest: The ceiling is below equilibrium, so it binds; if it were at or above equilibrium it would not bind. At a binding ceiling, supply is positive but less than demand, so shortage = Qd - Qs is not zero supply. The scene never claims that a price ceiling raises total surplus.
accessibility: Alt text, labeled axes and curves, keyboard slider, color-matched Qd and Qs dots, and a text description of the shortage gap.
